o1: Enables MAP kinase activity and RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding activity. Involved in defense response to other organism, including defense response to bacterium; the p38 MAPK cascade; behavioral response to nicotine; and positive regulation of macromolecule biosynthetic process. Is located in cytosol and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including germ line and intestine. Is part of the p38 MAPK signaling pathway. Predicted to interact with NSY-1 and SEK-1. Used to study colibacillosis (DOID:9256); enterotoxigenic Escherichia coli infection; and Parkinson's disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in colon cancer; colorectal carcinoma; nasopharynx carcinoma; and rectum cancer. Orthologous to human MAPK11 (mitogen-activated protein kinase 11) and MAPK14 (mitogen-activated protein kinase 14).
